evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 at 4.6 ppm, the same as the ~3-6 ppm baseline after purge.
O2 rose steadily through growth: 8.9, 12.7, 18.7, 24.3, then 26.0 ppm.
Argon flow is steady at ~100 sccm, so the rise is not from lost purge flow and the MFC is not stuck.
Temperature holds at 750 °C with heater power steady at ~45%, so thermal control is normal.
Controller status is 'running' and consistent with the telemetry.

args.missing_evidence: No pressure gauge is installed, so I can't rule out an exhaust blockage (which would show rising pressure) versus a seal leak. A leak check or a portable pressure reading on the tube would settle it. No characterization of the sample exists yet.
